title: Hadoop MapReduce Statistics Classes
description: The provided code implements a set of classes for managing and tracking statistics in the Hadoop MapReduce framework. The classes include Counters, CumulativePeriodicStats, PeriodicStatsAccumulator, ProgressSplitsBlock, StatePeriodicStats, and StatisticsCollector. The Counters class provides a way to compute the sum of two sets of counters. CumulativePeriodicStats is a concrete implementation of PeriodicStatsAccumulator that deals with measurements where the raw data are a measurement of an accumulation. It provides a way to estimate the progress-weighted change in the quantity over the progress range covered by the bucket. PeriodicStatsAccumulator is an abstract class that provides a way to accumulate and store time-varying measurements of a quantity during the execution of a task.

description: The "org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce" and "org.apache.hadoop.mapred" packages provide core classes and interfaces for handling input data in the Hadoop MapReduce framework. Additionally, the "org.apache.hadoop.mapred" package provides additional functionality for handling input data, including sampling, field selection, and partitioning. Together, these packages provide a comprehensive set of tools for processing and manipulating input data in a distributed computing environment.

title: Apache Hadoop MapReduce Manifest Committer
description: The Apache Hadoop MapReduce framework includes a manifest committer module responsible for managing manifest files and coordinating the output of MapReduce jobs. The manifest committer provides functionality for creating, updating, and deleting manifest files, as well as handling task and job attempts. The Java implementation of the manifest committer includes core logic for manifest file management, task and job attempt handling, and input/output operations. The module's behavior is influenced by dependencies on other components such as the OutputCommitter and TaskAttemptContext. Overall, the manifest committer plays a vital role in ensuring the successful completion of MapReduce jobs by managing manifest files and coordinating output.

The "org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.db" package provides a flexible and extensible way to interact with databases, while the "org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.input" package provides classes for reading data from various sources, including file systems and specific sources.

title: Value Aggregators and Chained MapReduce Jobs
description: The "org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.aggregate" and "org.apache.hadoop.mapred.lib.aggregate" packages provide a set of classes for performing various types of value aggregations in the context of Hadoop's MapReduce framework. These classes include value aggregators for summing up double and long values, finding the maximum and minimum values, deduplicating values, and computing histograms. Additionally, the "org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.chain" package provides a way to chain multiple MapReduce jobs together in a single job.
